title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Strikes 001 — Axial Thrust / Tool-First Recovery

principle.name: TOOL REACH OUTRUNS ROOT; RECOVERY REPAYS THE TOOL FIRST
principle.summary: A forceful thrust reads when the root braces and advances less than the striking tool. At contact, the tool and hands can begin recoil before the pelvis recenters; recovery is not reverse-play of the attack.
principle.negative_space: Anticipation clears the forward corridor by retracting the tool; commitment rapidly fills that corridor; recovery restores it by shortening reach before full-body restack.

vocabulary.TWOS: hold one key/drawing for two display frames
vocabulary.FOURS: hold one key/drawing for four display frames
vocabulary.STREET_FIGHTER_CAPCOM: nonuniform inferred gameplay timing with readable holds and fast causal transitions

keys.name: READY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root centered; tool held on a shallow forward axis

keys.name: ANTICIPATE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root lowers one cell; front corridor opens while staff retracts

keys.name: COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis shifts rearward; hands stack on attack axis before extension

keys.name: DRIVE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root advances modestly; tool tip advances much more than root

keys.name: CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: maximum tool reach; root remains behind tip; hit-stop implication only

keys.name: RECOIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: tip retracts first; elbows bend before pelvis recenters

keys.name: RETRACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: hands return near torso; root begins restack after tool is safely shortened

keys.name: RECOVER
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root restacked; negative space in front restored; ready state reacquired

motion_dungeon.interpolation: linear joints only within identical rig topology; CONTACT K4 is snapped from DRIVE K3
